_note: `let x: T` + `bind:this={x}` with reads only inside closures must not fire TS2454: Svelte assigns `x` when the element mounts, and TypeScript does not flow-check reads inside closures. Upstream leaves the declaration as written and assigns the element inside the template arrow; the same shape here keeps a direct top-level read reporting TS2454 (fixture 301) while closure reads stay clean.
